COVENANT DEFINITION — locked 2026-08-12, Stage 16.5, file 00r-what-is-a-covenant.md (commit cba470e).

berit (Hebrew) / diatheke (Greek). A covenant = a solemn, binding RELATIONSHIP established by commitments or promises — parties, obligations, signs, blessings, consequences, sometimes oath or sacrifice. Idiom: one CUTS a covenant (karat berit), tying covenant to sacrifice at vocabulary level (Gen 15's divided animals).

CORE DISTINCTION: THE COVENANT IS NOT IDENTICAL TO THE COMMANDMENTS ASSOCIATED WITH IT. A covenant contains obligations; obligations are not its definition.

SEVEN TERMS HELD APART (conflating = Category Collapse): COVENANT (the relational arrangement) / PROMISE (what Yahweh commits to accomplish) / COMMANDMENT (what Yahweh commands) / COVENANT OBLIGATION-STIPULATION (what a particular arrangement requires) / COVENANT SIGN (visible marker) / COVENANT BLESSING / COVENANT CURSE.

SHARPENING: covenant != promise. A covenant contains promises but is more relational and structured. EVERY COVENANT INVOLVES COMMITMENTS; NOT EVERY PROMISE IS A COVENANT.

'SHABBAT IS THE COVENANT' IS IMPRECISE — Shabbat is named a covenant SIGN (Ex 31:17), as are the rainbow (Gen 9:12-13) and circumcision (Gen 17:11). NOTE FOR THE LATER SHABBAT STAGE, DELIBERATELY NOT CASHED: Ex 31:17 roots Shabbat in CREATION, not only Sinai.

EIGHT STRUCTURAL QUESTIONS for any covenant: parties / relationship established / Yahweh's promise / required response / sign / blessings-curses / duration / purpose in the developing story.

MAJOR FINDING THE SIDEBAR PRODUCED: BERIT OLAM attaches to THREE institutions — RAINBOW (Gen 9:16), CIRCUMCISION (Gen 17:13), SHABBAT (Ex 31:16). Same Hebrew phrase. NO tradition treats all three identically: nobody says the rainbow covenant ended; the apostles didn't require circumcision of Gentiles; Shabbat is contested. This STRENGTHENS the OLAM brake, does not relieve it — the phrase alone cannot settle any case. EXPLICITLY DOES NOT MEAN olam = 'temporary' (that's the Anti-Replacement error, swapping one rigid reading for its opposite). It means olam is NOT the load-bearing word everyone assumes. Removes the temptation to treat one lexical verdict as decisive for circumcision + Shabbat + Ezekiel 37's sanctuary simultaneously.
TRANSLATION INCONSISTENCY: ESV renders the identical phrase 'everlasting covenant' (Gen 9:16, 17:13) but 'covenant forever' (Ex 31:16). CJB: 'perpetual' at Ex 31:16, 'everlasting' at Gen 17:13. RVR1960 most consistent: 'perpetuo' both places.

NEW FORMAL RULE — THE COVENANT RELATIONSHIP RULE (now in 00b + 00-methodology-current as rule 5): LATER COVENANT != AUTOMATIC CANCELLATION of preceding covenants. EARLIER COVENANT != every feature retaining identical administration forever. SCRIPTURE MUST TELL US THE RELATIONSHIP; NEVER INFERRED FROM SEQUENCE ALONE. Decisive test case = THE RAINBOW, precisely because it's uncontroversial: nobody argues circumcision replaced the rainbow covenant, and the ONLY reason is that Scripture never says so. WARRANT: Galatians 3:17 — the law 'came 430 years afterward, does not annul a covenant previously ratified by God.' Paul himself reasons that later covenantal/legal development does not automatically nullify an earlier divine promise.

'ADDENDUM' INTUITION MODIFIED NOT REJECTED: addendum implies terms appended to one unchanged contract. The biblical form is Gal 3:17 — a claim about PROMISES NOT BEING ANNULLED. Covenant sequence: Noah (rainbow) -> Abraham (circumcision) -> Sinai (Torah/priesthood/sanctuary/sacrifice) -> David (house/throne/kingdom) -> New (Jer 31). Noah wasn't a failed first attempt; Sinai isn't 'Abraham 2.0'; David doesn't erase Abraham. Story becomes MORE SPECIFIC, concentrating toward Messiah. BUT Jeremiah adds what accumulation alone can't hold: a covenant genuinely BROKEN — yet Yahweh does NOT say everything prior is canceled. Continuity and discontinuity both preserved; neither half swallows the other. The Stage 15 refinement SURVIVES and is strengthened: 'one covenantal story containing multiple covenants, culminating in Messiah.'

TWO CJB TRANSLATION DATA RECORDED NOT ADOPTED: (1) diatheke rendered 'oath' at Gal 3:17 — interpretive, Greek is not horkos; (2) CJB inserts 'the legal part of the Torah' twice where ESV/RVR1960 read simply 'the law' — importing the very moral/civil/ceremonial-style partition that Category Collapse's SECOND FACE flags as theological taxonomy rather than biblical terminology.

REFRAMES STAGE 17 RETROACTIVELY: the circumcision question is NOT 'did Yahweh repeal a rule?' but 'WHAT HAPPENED TO THE SIGN'S COVENANTAL BOUNDARY-MARKER FUNCTION?' — which is why 00q section 20's classification produced NO row reading 'abolished'; every row describes a CHANGE IN FUNCTION.

SEQUENCE NOTE (ADR-0007 demonstration): 00r was written AFTER 00q but is numbered Stage 16.5 because the spine records ARGUMENT order while file letters record CREATION order. Nothing in Stage 17 was rewritten to pretend this came first. The two architectures are allowed to disagree — that is why both exist.

BIBLE-2tj: as of 2026-08-14 commit a8e60cd. 30 content files + 9 ADRs. Methodology v1.8. STAGES DONE THROUGH 19. Spine: 26 stages (19 + inserted 16.5, 18.5-18.10).

READ 00-methodology-current.md FIRST. ADR-0009 three provenance layers in force.

STAGE 19 = 00w-sabbath-creation-covenant-sign-shadow-rest.md. STRONGEST TEST OF THE METHODOLOGY YET — Sabbath fits NEITHER 'Mosaic therefore temporary' NOR 'creation ordinance therefore unchanged forever'. SIX usually-collapsed questions separated first: when seventh-day holiness first appears / who is commanded / what it signifies / what changes under Messiah / whether the day continues / whether Gentiles are ever commanded.

- GEN 2:2-3: Yahweh RESTS, BLESSES, SANCTIFIES the seventh day. Predates Abraham/Israel/Sinai/Levi/Moses. Hebrew shavat -> Shabbat. *** FIRST BRAKE, LOAD-BEARING: GENESIS 2 DOES NOT COMMAND ADAM AND EVE TO OBSERVE IT. *** May say 'creation-rooted'. May NOT say 'Genesis 2 commands every human forever' — needs separate evidence.
- EXOD 16: instruction BEFORE Sinai's Decalogue; 16:28 Yahweh calls it 'MY COMMANDMENTS AND MY LAWS'. So the command isn't first appearing on the tablets.
- EXOD 20:11 grounds it in CREATION (zakhor = remember, itself suggestive). DEUT 5:15 adds a SECOND rationale: REDEMPTION from Egypt. So Sabbath signifies CREATION + REST + FREEDOM + PROVISION — not 'don't work Saturday'.
- *** BUT EXOD 31:13/16-17 MAKES IT AN EXPLICIT COVENANT SIGN (Hebrew OT) WITH ISRAEL. BOTH FACTS STAND; NEITHER ERASES THE OTHER. THAT IS THE TENSION AND AN HONEST READING CARRIES BOTH. *** Per 00r: Sabbath is a SIGN, like rainbow and circumcision — not the covenant itself.
- NUM 15:32-36 stick-gatherer executed: Sabbath belonged deeply to Israel's covenantal order, not optional personal spirituality. Prophets treat violation as covenant unfaithfulness.
- ISAIAH 56:3, 6-7: FOREIGNERS who join themselves to Yahweh, KEEP SABBATH, hold covenant, brought to His holy mountain; 'a house of prayer for ALL PEOPLES' (the verse Yeshua invokes re the Temple). SO SABBATH CANNOT BE DISMISSED AS AN ETHNIC CUSTOM OUTSIDERS NEVER TOUCHED. BRAKE: does NOT establish post-resurrection Gentile obligation — different question. FOURTH APPEARANCE OF THE GER THREAD (after Ex 12:48, Lev 17-18, Ex 20:10).
- YESHUA DOES NOT BEHAVE LIKE SOMEONE WHO DESPISES SABBATH. Luke 4:16 'as was his custom'. THE CONTROVERSIES ARE YESHUA VS PARTICULAR INTERPRETATIONS, not Yeshua vs Sabbath (same shape as Mark 7).
- MARK 2:27 made for ANTHROPOS (human/humankind), NOT 'for the Jew'. LEXICAL-FALLACY BRAKE APPLIED: anthropos alone doesn't prove universal obligation. What it establishes: Sabbath grounded in HUMAN BENEFIT not oppression. MARK 2:28 He claims LORDSHIP over it — not that it no longer matters.
- MATT 12:12 / MARK 3:4: note the word LAWFUL. Argument is NOT 'the Law doesn't matter so I'll heal' but 'THIS IS WHAT LAWFUL SABBATH FAITHFULNESS LOOKS LIKE'. Fits Sabbath's own themes (creation restored, slaves liberated). Healing on Sabbath is close to a LIVING PARABLE of what Sabbath means.
- HEBREWS 4:8-11: 'there remains a SABBATISMOS for the people of God'; 4:10 reaches explicitly back to GENESIS 2's creation rest. BUT NOTE WHAT HEBREWS DOES NOT SAY: it neither abolishes weekly Sabbath NOR commands Gentiles to observe Saturday.

*** MAJOR TRANSLATION FINDING (open q 50) *** Hebrews AVOIDS the ordinary SABBATON and uses SABBATISMOS. ESV: 'a Sabbath REST' (a STATE entered). CJB: 'a Shabbat-KEEPING' (an OBSERVANCE practiced). DIVERGES ALONG THE EXACT FAULT LINE UNDER INVESTIGATION. The -ismos ending is verbal in shape (an -ing), which is why CJB reads it so — BUT MORPHOLOGY DOESN'T SETTLE THE REFERENT. Interest noted both directions and settling nothing (CJB Messianic Jewish, ESV traditional-Christian). Same category as Mark 7:19's parenthesis and Matt 24:34's 'this people'.

- ROMANS 14:5: ESTABLISHED Paul permits differing convictions on religious days. NOT ESTABLISHED that he means weekly Sabbath. Therefore it can neither abolish NOR mandate Sabbath alone.
- ACTS HELD AT ACTUAL WEIGHT: Paul in synagogues on Sabbath is WHEN JEWS GATHERED — does NOT establish his personal theology of mandatory observance. Clean OBSERVATION-vs-INTERPRETATION case. Acts 13:42/44 'next Sabbath' kept as evidence WITHOUT INFLATION.
- ACTS 15 CONSPICUOUS AGAIN: Sabbath NOT among the Gentile requirements — THAT IS EVIDENCE — but 15:21 has Moses read every Sabbath. THE APOSTOLIC EVIDENCE IS GENUINELY AMBIGUOUS ON MANDATORY GENTILE OBSERVANCE AND HONESTY REQUIRES SAYING SO.
- ISAIAH 66:23 (open q 51): 'from new moon to new moon, and from Sabbath to Sabbath, ALL FLESH shall come to worship before me' — AFTER the new-heavens-and-earth of 66:22. Makes 'Sabbath belonged only to Sinai and disappears' HARDER TO SUSTAIN. MARKED: HIGH RELEVANCE, ESCHATOLOGICAL INTERPRETATION UNRESOLVED — placement relative to New Jerusalem / covenant transition / AD 70 / Rev 21-22 not investigated. (Isaiah 65:20's death-at-100 complication already flagged at Stage 13 — same passage-complex already difficult.)
- *** THE EZEKIEL CONSISTENCY BRAKE, CUTS BOTH WAYS *** Ezekiel's temple vision includes Sabbaths, new moons, AND SACRIFICES, priesthood, measurements. IF ISAIAH'S FUTURE SABBATH PROVES A LITERAL FUTURE SABBATH, CONSISTENCY DEMANDS ASKING WHAT WE'RE DOING WITH EZEKIEL'S FUTURE SACRIFICES. WE MAY NOT LITERALIZE WHICHEVER PROPHETIC INSTITUTION SUPPORTS OUR POSITION AND SYMBOLIZE THE INCONVENIENT ONES. Isaiah 56 + Isaiah 66 + Ezekiel 40-48 eventually need their own prophetic-control study.

FULL A/B/C/D CLASSIFICATION RECORDED. Tier A = 12 explicit observations standing simultaneously. Tier B synthesis = Sabbath signifies creation/divine rest/holiness/covenant/liberation/provision/mercy/restoration/Messianic rest. Tier C hypothesis = weekly Sabbath functions as temporal shadow/pattern of the greater rest in Messiah. *** TIER D — NOT ESTABLISHED IN BOTH DIRECTIONS: not that every Gentile believer is commanded to observe identically to Mosaic Israel; NOT that Messiah abolished seventh-day holiness; NOT that Messiah transformed Sabbath into Sunday. ***

SUNDAY IS A COMPLETELY SEPARATE QUESTION (open q 52). Even concluding Sabbath isn't obligatory for Gentiles would NOT establish Sunday as the new Sabbath. The inference 'Sabbath not mandatory -> therefore Sunday replaced Sabbath' is LOGICALLY INVALID without a further bridge: resurrection on the first day / Acts 20:7 / 1 Cor 16:2 / Rev 1:10 'the Lord's Day' / post-apostolic evidence. Deliberately not pursued.

*** NEW FORMAL RULE — DO NOT CONFUSE REMOVAL WITH REPLACEMENT (00b + methodology v1.8) *** FULFILLMENT MUST BE DEMONSTRATED; REPLACEMENT MUST BE DEMONSTRATED SEPARATELY. If Scripture modifies/fulfills/removes an institution, that does NOT establish that a later practice REPLACED it. Replacement requires POSITIVE EVIDENCE FOR THE REPLACEMENT. Blocks the TWO-STEP SLIDE arguments routinely take at once. Applies to: Israel->Church / Sabbath->Sunday / Passover->Easter / biblical feasts->later Christian calendar / priesthood->ecclesiastical priesthood. COMPANION TO FULFILLMENT != ABOLITION — that blocks assuming the pattern is gone; THIS blocks assuming something else is in its seat.

*** NEXT STAGE: HEBREWS 4 SURGICALLY — SABBATISMOS. DELIBERATELY NOT SUNDAY *** (not jumping to Sunday is ITSELF an application of the new rule — the Sunday question only becomes live once a replacement is being CLAIMED, and none has been demonstrated). ENORMOUS difference between 'Messiah is our Sabbath, therefore the day disappeared' and what Hebrews actually says: 'there remains a SABBATISMOS for the people of God'. THREE DETERMINATIONS: (1) what sabbatismos meant in its linguistic/historical setting, and WHY Hebrews chose it over sabbaton (CJB 'Shabbat-keeping' vs ESV 'Sabbath rest' hangs on this); (2) how Hebrews builds the argument GENESIS 2 -> WILDERNESS ISRAEL -> PSALM 95 -> JOSHUA -> 'TODAY' -> MESSIAH; (3) *** IS THE REST ALREADY ENTERED, STILL FUTURE, OR BOTH? *** That third question could RECONNECT SABBATH TO THE ESCHATOLOGICAL FRAMEWORK BUILT SINCE STAGE 7, because ALREADY/NOT-YET/BOTH is the same structural question the millennium, the 'little season', and Matthew 24 keep raising. NOTE THE CONVERGENCE: this is the THIRD line arriving at that junction from a NON-PROPHETIC direction, after Acts 21's AD 70 question (q45) and Colossians 2's ton mellonton (q48).

STILL QUEUED: Stage 18 PROVISIONAL VERDICT on clean/unclean food (what the evidence strongly establishes / leans toward / remains genuinely uncertain / AND WHAT CANNOT RESPONSIBLY BE CLAIMED).
